📋 First Principles Scorecard

1. Earns Rent?
Does this skill directly serve revenue, hiring, or operations? Top 20 = yes. Everything else is support or debt.
2. Findable?
Can you find the right skill in under 10 seconds? Search + team filter + "say this" trigger = yes.
3. Honest?
Real usage data from .usage.json — not opinion. Skills are sorted by actual activity, not a locked guess.
4. Safe?
Right permission on the right door. Team-safe = store staff can use. Louis-only = owner only. Unset = fix now.
5. Lean?
No dead weight. 0-activity skills go to Debt tab. Archive if cold. Kill if useless. 80/20 or die.
🔥 80/20 Rule
Top 20 skills ≠ equal weight to 120+. The Earn Rent tab is your 80/20. The rest is drawer noise.

🔁 The Loop (how this stays honest)

1. Work in Slack
→
2. Skill auto-loads
→
3. Usage counted
→
4. Rebuild Dojo
→
5. See what earns rent

⚠️ Pitfalls

• Stale Dojo after hermes skills install without rebuild → always rebuild after install
• Slack blocklist paths (agents/foo) silently fail → use skill names only
• Parking cold skills in _archive/ → still loaded → use .archive/
• Putting full skills into Supabase → wrong layer → Brain = data, not skill files
• Restarting gateway from Slack bot session → blocked → use Mac Terminal.app

Pathwiserise/people-recruiting

People Recruiting — Runbook

When to Use This

You need to hire someone for a restaurant position (server, cook, host, bartender, dishwasher, prep, sushi chef, busser, etc.) at a specific store.

How to Start

Say this in your store's Slack channel:

Need 1 Server

Replace the number and role as needed. Examples: - Need 2 Cooks - Need 1 Host - Need 1 Dishwasher

Only the GM (General Manager) can request hires. If you're not the GM, ask your GM to post it.

What Happens Next (The Full Flow)

Stage 1 — Recruiting (Steps 1–7)

Step 1 — You Post the Request - Post "Need N [role]" in your store channel as a new message - WISE OPS detects your store from the channel automatically (never asks "which store") - Verifies you are the GM

Step 2 — WISE OPS Records the Request - Creates a record in the system with status "recruiting" - Replies in your thread with a confirmation

Step 3 — WISE OPS Checks If You Actually Need This Person - Compares how many people you have now (from 7shifts) vs how many you need (from your Staff Count Sheet) - Formula: MIN = weekly shifts ÷ 4, SAFE = MIN × 1.25, GAP = SAFE − current count - If you're within the gap → auto-approved, pipeline opens - If hiring would put you over the safe number → HR must approve in the thread first. Reply approve or decline.

Step 4 — Job Opens on the Careers Website - WISE OPS confirms a job posting is live on your careers site (e.g., eatatgangnam.com/careers) - Candidates who apply online flow into the system automatically - The pipeline is always open — it never closes

Step 5 — WISE OPS Sends You Candidates - As candidates apply and score above 60, WISE OPS posts a shortlist in your thread - Shortlist is limited to top candidates (gap + 2, max 5) - Two tiers: - 🔥 Call Today (score 80–100) — strong candidate, call same day - 📋 Interview (score 60–79) — passed initial screen, schedule an interview - Each candidate shows: name, score, apply date, email, phone, availability, experience - Ask for detail on any candidate to get personalized interview questions

⭐ GATE 1 — You Pick Who to Hire (Human Decision)

This is your decision. WISE OPS will never auto-hire.

  • Reply in the thread with a number to pick a candidate (e.g., "1" or "Pick 2")
  • Or reply with the candidate's name
  • WISE OPS confirms the pick and moves to Step 7

Step 7 — Hired - WISE OPS updates the record to "hired" - Posts a hire confirmation in your thread - Notifies HR channel and Ops channel - Onboarding begins automatically

Stage 2 — Onboarding (Steps 8–14, Mostly Automatic)

After hire, most of the work is automated. Here's what happens:

Step 8 — 7shifts Account Created (Auto) - WISE OPS creates a 7shifts account for the new hire - 7shifts sends an invite email to the employee - Training courses auto-assigned (New Hire Basics + role-specific course) - HR channel gets a notification

Step 9 — Chowbus + Gusto Accounts Created (Auto) - 7shifts integration auto-creates a Chowbus (POS) account - 7shifts integration auto-creates a Gusto (payroll) account - This takes up to 24 hours (syncs at 5 AM daily) - If stuck beyond 24 hours, HR is notified

Step 10 — WISE OPS Watches and Nudges (Auto) - Monitors setup progress - If something is stuck (e.g., employee hasn't accepted invite), HR is nudged - HR handles stuck accounts — you don't need to chase

Step 11 — I-9 / E-Verify (Auto, Legal Gate) - Gusto handles I-9 and E-Verify automatically - No employee goes Active without I-9 on file — this is a legal requirement - If I-9 is missing, WISE OPS blocks activation and notifies HR

⭐ GATE 2 — Training Checklist (Your Decision)

This is the only human action in Stage 2.

When all 4 setup steps are complete (7shifts, Chowbus, Gusto, I-9), WISE OPS posts a training checklist in your thread:

🎯 Train · [Name] Setup done. Mark days 1–5. 👉 @[GM] reply day 1 done [trainer]

What you do: - After each training day, reply in the thread: - day 1 done Levi (day number + trainer name required) - day 2 done Sarah - day 3 done Mike - etc. - If a training day fails: day 3 fail - After all 5 days: reply pass or fail

Rules: - Trainer name is required for each "done" day - No auto-pass — you must explicitly reply pass - Any fail = employee stays in onboarding - No reply = no pass = stays in onboarding

Step 13 — Employee Activated (Auto) - When all conditions are met (7shifts ✅, Chowbus ✅, Gusto ✅, I-9 ✅, training passed ✅) - WISE OPS activates the employee automatically - Posts activation notice in your thread - Notifies Ops to add to the schedule

Step 14 — Cross-Department Handoff (Auto) - Ops channel notified: position filled → employee active → add to schedule

Walk-In Hire (Bypass Steps 1–6)

If you hired someone face-to-face (walk-in, referral, or internal transfer), you skip the candidate pipeline entirely.

Say this in your store channel:

Hired walk-in John Smith, Server, john@email.com, 555-1234

Or:

Walk-in hire: Host, Sarah Lee

What happens: - WISE OPS detects the store from the channel - Verifies you are the GM - Checks for duplicates (by email and phone) before creating a record - Creates the record with status "hired" directly - Jumps to Step 7 (hire confirmation + onboarding)

If the person already exists in the system, WISE OPS will ask you to confirm before creating a duplicate.

Interview Sheet Photo Upload

If you have a completed paper Interview Sheet (handwritten form from an interview):

  1. Take a photo of the completed sheet
  2. Upload it to your store channel with a message like "onboard this candidate" or "hired this person"
  3. WISE OPS reads the handwritten data (name, email, phone, scores, decision)
  4. If the sheet says "Hire" — treated as a walk-in hire, goes straight to Step 7
  5. Pay rate is auto-filled from the Pay Band Policy if left blank

Human Gates Summary

Gate Who What You Do How
Gate 1 GM Pick which candidate to hire Reply with a number in the thread
Over-Gap HR Approve hiring above safe staffing level Reply approve or decline in the thread
Gate 2 GM Mark 5 training days + pass/fail Reply day N done [trainer] then pass or fail

Everything else is automated. You never need to: - Create accounts manually (7shifts, Chowbus, Gusto are auto) - Send onboarding packages (7shifts auto-sends on invite accept) - Track I-9 (Gusto handles it) - Activate employees (WISE OPS does it when all conditions are met)

What You'll See When It Works

  1. Request confirmed — thread reply with gap count and "pipeline open"
  2. Candidates shortlisted — numbered list with scores and apply dates in your thread
  3. Hire confirmed — "Hired ✅" message in your thread
  4. Training checklist — "Setup done, mark days 1–5" in your thread (after all accounts created)
  5. Employee activated — "Active ✅" message in your thread

All messages stay in one thread per employee. Your store channel stays clean.

If Something Goes Wrong

Problem What to Do
WISE OPS asks "which store?" You're in the wrong channel. Post in your store's channel, not a department channel.
"Only the GM can request hires" Ask your GM to post the request.
No candidates appearing The pipeline may be dry. Check eatatgangnam.com/careers to verify the job is live. HR can boost via ads (ask Louis).
Hire stuck — no 7shifts invite Employee needs to check email and accept the 7shifts invite. If stuck 3+ days, HR follows up.
Chowbus/Gusto not creating This can take up to 24 hours (syncs at 5 AM). If stuck longer, HR escalates to Integrations team.
I-9 blocked Employee cannot go Active. HR chases Gusto. Do not schedule the employee until I-9 is complete.
Training not starting Training only starts after all 4 setup steps are done (7shifts, Chowbus, Gusto, I-9). Wait for the checklist message.
Duplicate person created Reply in the thread to flag it. WISE OPS will merge or correct.

Pay Rate Reference

All new hires start at training rate. Band rate kicks in after training passes (Gate 2).

People Roster Sync — Runbook

When to Use This

You need to know who works at a store, how many active people you have, or whether your team list is accurate.

Common questions this answers: - "Who works here?" - "How many servers do we have?" - "What's our headcount?" - "Is the roster clean?" - "Are there people in 7shifts missing from the system?"

How to Start

Say this in your store's Slack channel:

roster

Or any of these: - headcount - who works here - team list - how many servers do we have - staffing - check 7shifts (to compare Brain vs 7shifts)

WISE OPS detects your store from the channel automatically.

What Happens Next

Step 1 — WISE OPS Pulls Your Roster - Reads the live roster from the system (Brain), not from a spreadsheet - Detects your store from the channel (never asks "which store")

Step 2 — WISE OPS Counts Current Active Staff by Role - Counts only active employees (not hired/in-training, not terminated) - Groups by role: GM, AGM, Floor Manager, Server, Host, Busser, Cook, etc. - Separates out: - Pipeline (hired but not yet active — still in onboarding) - Unknown role (people with "Team Member" or blank position — data issue)

Step 3 — WISE OPS Flags Data Issues Checks for: - Duplicate names (same person twice) - Bad names (email addresses in name field, formatting junk) - Missing or "Team Member" positions (should be a real role like Server, Cook, etc.) - People hired more than 14 days ago but still not active (stuck onboarding) - People active in the system but not in 7shifts (may have left)

Step 4 — WISE OPS Replies in Your Thread

You'll see something like:

📋 Roster — Gangnam Wilmington · 00003

CURRENT (active): GM 1 · Floor 2 · Server 18 · Host 6 · Bus 5
Bodies active: 32  ·  Pipeline hired: 3  ·  Unknown role: 0

✅ Data: Clean

👉 Hire seats: run min-safe-gap · Board: run scheduling

If there are data issues, you'll see:

⚠️ Data: 2 dupes, 1 bad name, 3 unknown role

Step 5 — If You Want Names (Optional)

Ask "show me names" or "who are the servers?" and WISE OPS will post the full name list by role in the thread.

Step 6 — If You Want to Check 7shifts

Say "check 7shifts" and WISE OPS will: - Pull the active 7shifts list for your store - Compare to the Brain roster - Show who's in 7shifts but missing from Brain - Offer to import missing people (with your approval — never auto-imports)

Step 7 — If You Want to Know Who Left

Ask "who left?" or "ghosts?" and WISE OPS will: - Compare Brain active vs 7shifts active - List people who are active in Brain but not in 7shifts (may have left) - Never auto-terminates anyone — just reports for you to confirm

What You'll See When It Works

  1. Roster summary — role counts first, total bodies, pipeline count, unknown role count
  2. Data health — clean ✅ or issues flagged ⚠️
  3. Optional name list — full names by role in the thread
  4. Optional 7shifts compare — missing people table if you asked
  5. Optional drift report — people who may have left (read-only, no auto-fire)

Important Rules

Rule Why
Only active employees count toward CURRENT Hired/in-training people aren't on the floor yet
"Team Member" or blank position = data issue Can't do hire math without a real role
Shift Lead ≠ Floor Manager Shift Lead is not a boss role
Never auto-terminate anyone Only Louis or Yumi can approve termination
Never auto-import from 7shifts WISE OPS asks first — you say "yes"
Headcount budget (~20) is stale and ignored Real active count is often 40–50 per store
HQ staff (Louis, Luna, Anson, Alin) never count as store CURRENT They're HQ, not store employees

If Something Goes Wrong

Problem What to Do
Roster looks empty or very small Say "check 7shifts" — Brain may be missing people who are active in 7shifts. WISE OPS will offer to import.
"Unknown role" count is high Some employees have "Team Member" or blank positions. Tell WISE OPS their real roles, or ask the GM to update.
Duplicate names Same person entered twice. Tell WISE OPS "clean it up" and it will keep the best record.
Person hired 14+ days ago, still not active Onboarding is stuck. Check their 7shifts/Chowbus/Gusto/I-9 status. May need HR follow-up.
Person active in Brain but not in 7shifts They may have left. WISE OPS reports this as "drift" — confirm with the GM, then Louis/Yumi approve termination.
Brain and 7shifts counts don't match Normal — Brain may include people who left 7shifts but weren't terminated in Brain yet. Run "check 7shifts" to see the gap.

What This Skill Does NOT Do

Question Right Skill
"How many people do we need to hire?" min-safe-gap (computes SAFE − CURRENT = GAP)
"I need to hire a server" people-recruiting (starts the hiring flow)
"Build the schedule" people-scheduling (builds the 7shifts board)
"Fire this person" people-termination (Louis/Yumi approval required)

This skill is purely about seeing who's on your team right now and keeping that list accurate.

Automatic Background Sync

WISE OPS runs a daily sync at 5 AM that: 1. Pulls active 7shifts employees for each store 2. Imports any missing from Brain (add-only, never deletes) 3. Publishes CURRENT by role (used for hire math) 4. Flags data issues

You don't need to trigger this — it runs automatically. But if the roster looks stale or wrong, you can always ask WISE OPS to "sync roster" or "check 7shifts" to force a fresh pull.

Restaurant Role Quick Reference

Term Role Department
Server Waiter/waitress (takes orders, serves food) FOH
Host / Hostess Greets and seats guests FOH
Bartender Makes drinks FOH
Busser / Busboy Clears tables FOH
Cook Line cook BOH
Prep Prep cook BOH
Dishwasher Dishwasher BOH
Sushi Chef Sushi chef BOH
GM General Manager MGMT
AGM Assistant General Manager MGMT
Floor Manager Floor Manager MGMT
Kitchen Manager Kitchen Manager MGMT

FOH = Front of House (dining room) · BOH = Back of House (kitchen) · MGMT = Management

Pathwiserise/wiserise-weekly-onething-focus

Weekly Focus Memo

🎯 Purpose

Turn each department’s Friday memo into one clear weekly plan for Monday. The plan shows what improved, what failed, and what needs focus next week.

👥 When to Use This

Use this workflow when a department leader sends a Friday weekly memo with:

  • Last-week results
  • What failed
  • Next-week proposals
  • Known owners, due dates, or proof of completion

This workflow covers HR/People, Operations, Finance, and Marketing.

💬 How to Start

Send the completed Friday memo to WISE OPS in Slack.

Use this format:

Department · Friday date
Last-week results + proof
What failed
Next-week proposals
Owner / due date / Done proof where known

Example:

Department: HR
Leader: Sally
Last week: Improve time-punch accuracy at Gangnam Wilmington
What failed: 7shifts and Chowbus data did not match
Next week: Continue recruiting and review schedules with managers

🔄 What Happens Next

1. Friday — Memo received

WISE OPS checks the department, date, results, failures, and proposals.

✅ You will receive confirmation that the memo was received.

2. After all department memos arrive — Monday draft prepared

WISE OPS combines the department memos into one shared weekly plan. Each department gets its own section.

The draft shows:

  • Results from last week
  • What failed
  • Proposed focus items for next week

3. Monday — Review and choose priorities ⭐ GATE

Louis and department leaders review the combined plan together. They choose three focus items per department.

Each item needs:

  • One owner
  • A due date
  • A clear definition of Done
  • Proof that will show the work is complete

4. Monday — Weekly plan locked

After approval, WISE OPS locks the plan and creates a work item for each approved focus item. The department channel receives a short confirmation.

5. Wednesday — Blocker check

Owners update each item as:

  1. Working
  2. Needs help
  3. Done — with strong proof

WISE OPS alerts Louis only when an item needs help or is overdue.

6. Friday — Results reviewed

Owners report whether each item was Better, Same, or Worse and include proof. Unfinished items carry forward. An item carried forward for two weeks is sent to Louis for a Keep, Change, or Kill decision.

⭐ Human Gates

Person Decision or action Reply / action
Department leader Submit the Friday memo Send the completed memo to WISE OPS
Louis + department leader Choose three focus items Approve, change, or remove proposed items on Monday
Focus-item owner Report progress Wednesday Reply: Working / Needs help / Done + details
Focus-item owner Report Friday result Reply: Better / Same / Worse + proof
Louis Decide on stuck items Choose Keep, Change, or Kill after two carry-forwards

✅ What You’ll See When It Works

Friday

✅ Memo saved · HR · 8/7
Items reviewed · proposals recorded
👉 Louis reviews Monday

Monday

📋 Weekly Focus Plan · HR · Week of 8/10
3 focus items approved · Plan is ready
👉 Review owners and due dates

Wednesday

Only blocked items require escalation. A normal progress update stays with the department owner.

Friday results

The summary names each topic and its result. It does not use only totals such as “2 done.”

⛔ If Something Goes Wrong

Problem What to do
Memo was not acknowledged Resend it to WISE OPS using the required format
A department is missing from Monday’s plan Tell Louis which department is missing
A proposed item has no owner Assign an owner during the Monday review
An item has no clear Done proof Define the proof before approving the item
An owner needs help Reply with the blocker, the person needed, and a help-by date
An item is still unfinished after two weeks Louis decides Keep, Change, or Kill
Payroll or time-punch data is wrong Flag the specific store, date, and mismatch for review

🚶 Shortcut Paths

  • If a memo arrives late, send it to WISE OPS immediately; do not wait for Monday.
  • If only one item needs help, report only that item in its work thread.
  • If a result is already complete, include the proof in the Friday memo.
  • If a proposal is no longer important, remove it during the Monday review rather than creating a work item.

📋 Reference Table

Rule Standard
Memos One Friday memo per department
Weekly plan One combined plan for all departments
Focus items Three per department
Completion Strong proof is required
Wednesday Blockers and progress only
Carry-forward Escalate after two consecutive weeks
Decision owner Louis and the department leader
